# Greener-Dalii · 格润达理

> Intelligence is no longer scarce. Leverage is the new company. Trust is the new currency.
> 智力不再稀缺。杠杆才是新的公司。信任是新的通货。

## About

Greener-Dalii (格润达理) builds the infrastructure of the AI-native era. We are a small team running on leverage and trust by construction — everything open source, every number public, no curtain.

## Products

- obsidian-llm-wiki: A local-first Obsidian plugin that turns your files into a queryable knowledge base where every answer cites its source.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/obsidian-llm-wiki
- pi-shift-router: Auto-routing for coding agents — the right model for every task, with automatic failover and zero runtime dependencies.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/pi-shift-router
  - https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-shift-router
